mainEntity.name: What does a turnkey office fit out include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everything needed to turn an empty unit into a working office: space planning, office interior design, 3D visuals, authority approvals, partitions, ceilings, flooring, joinery, lighting, MEP works, data cabling, AV, branding, snagging and handover documents. Loose furniture is not included; we plan the layout around the furniture you choose.

mainEntity.name: How much does an office fit out cost in Dubai and Abu Dhabi?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our office fit out projects start from 250 sqm. Rates start from AED 2,500 per sqm for a Budget finish, AED 3,500 per sqm for Executive and AED 6,000 per sqm for Premium, excluding VAT and loose furniture. The package cards above show a starting estimate for each office size.

mainEntity.name: How long does a new office fit out take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Design and approvals usually take 4-9 weeks. Work on site takes around 8-10 weeks for 250 sqm, 12-14 weeks for 600 sqm and 16-22 weeks for a full floor of 1,500 sqm. We run design and permitting in parallel wherever the authorities allow.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Cat A and Cat B fit out?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cat A is the landlord base build: raised floor, ceiling grid, basic lighting and air conditioning. Cat B is the tenant fit out that makes it your office: partitions, finishes, joinery, adapted MEP, AV and branding. Our turnkey packages are Cat B. If your unit is shell and core, we price the Cat A works separately.

mainEntity.name: Are you an interior contractor or an interior designer?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both. We are a design and build company, so the same team designs your office, secures the approvals and builds it. You sign one contract and have one point of responsibility, which avoids the gaps that appear when a designer and a separate fit out contractor work to different scopes.

mainEntity.name: Do you handle fit outs in free zones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deliver office fit outs in Dubai Media City, Internet City, DIFC, DMCC, JAFZA, ADGM, Masdar City and KEZAD, following each free zone's fit out guidelines and submission process.
No. Loose furniture is not part of our fit out scope. We plan the layout, give your furniture supplier exact sizes and power positions, and coordinate delivery with the site programme.

mainEntity.name: What guarantees do you give after handover?

acceptedAnswer.text: You receive as-built drawings, operation and maintenance manuals and completion certificates. We remain responsible for defects during the liability period in your contract, and maintenance support is available afterwards.
